headline: Committee defers Martin settlement, passes Myers-Nave legal fee resolution

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.summary: The settlement in Charlotte Martin v. County of Maui (Resolution 26-81) was deferred. A motion to adopt Resolution 26-82, adding $240,000 for Myers-Nave's wildfire lawsuit work, passed with eight ayes and one excused, and it goes to the full council.
meeting.recap: No one signed up to give public testimony at the start of the meeting.[[0:02:34]] The first item was Resolution 26-81, a settlement in the lawsuit Charlotte Martin v. the County of Maui.[[0:03:31]] The chair said the trial was postponed, so the County's lawyer asked to delay it.[[0:04:04]] The second item was Resolution 26-82, which adds $240,000 to pay the law firm Myers-Nave, for a total of up to $740,000.[[0:06:33]] The County cut another $93,000, leaving $240,000 to pay.[[0:08:14]] The committee passed a motion to adopt the resolution, with eight ayes and one member excused.[[0:21:02]] The resolution now goes to the full council.[[0:21:40]]
